about.title: About Amon
about.intro: Amon is a smart AI Coworker running locally. It doesn't just chat with you -- it can actually help you get work done: writing code, running commands, searching information, and managing files.
about.feature1Desc: A smart assistant that can execute tasks, manage files, and run code -- not just a chatbot
about.feature2Desc: Data stored locally, protecting your privacy and security
about.feature3Desc: Adapt to different work scenarios with powerful built-in tools
about.feature4Desc: Provides a friendly graphical interface for AI coding
about.dataDirectoryDesc: Session records and settings files are stored in the local config directory.
